caption: Flo caters a film studio: fifty levels of production crews, divas and craft-services chaos.

req.note: 2003-2011 casual 2d, single-digit-to-double-digit-megabytes install. runs on anything, including hardware far below the target bar.

links.official_note: no official channel survives. playfirst folded into glu mobile in 2014, playfirst.com is dead, and the portals that carried the dash line closed with it. the pc build has nowhere legal left to be sold.
links.anyway_note: this is the un-buyable case: no store, no key server, no publisher counter. the archive route is the only route.

about: Cooking Dash: DinerTown Studios, released on 3 september 2009, moves Flo's kitchen onto a movie lot, with development again by Aliasworlds entertainment under playfirst. Fifty levels across five film sets feed production crews, actors and directors whose patience runs on a director's temper.

The cooking core is intact, but the studio dressing changes the rhythm: props and set pieces interrupt service, and the crowd types arrive in production-sized waves. It is the second Cooking Dash and the last one built around the original kitchen loop.
Its store channels died with the publisher - the 2009 build is un-buyable and preserved through archives only.
